name: Exp_ExchangePrice
summary: This EA trades based on the custom ExchangePrice indicator, generating buy signals when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell signals when it crosses below. It uses a new-bar check to avoid repeated entries on the same bar, and manages positions with configurable Stop Loss, Take Profit, and multiple money management modes including lot-based and margin-based sizing.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义ExchangePrice指标进行交易，当指标线上穿信号线时生成买入信号，下穿时生成卖出信号。EA使用新K线检查避免同一根K线上重复入场，并通过可配置的止损、止盈以及多种资金管理模式（包括固定手数和基于保证金的仓位计算）来管理持仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于自定义ExchangePrice指标的两条线（主线Ind和信号线Sign）的交叉来判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当Ind[1]>Sign[1]（上一根K线主线在信号线上方）且Ind[0]<=Sign[0]（再上一根K线主线在信号线下方或相等）时，确认上升趋势启动，触发买入开仓；反之当Ind[1]<Sign[1]且Ind[0]>=Sign[0]时确认下降趋势启动，触发卖出开仓。出场条件包括：做多时若出现下降趋势信号则平多仓，做空时若出现上升趋势信号则平空仓，同时每笔交易都设有StopLoss和TakeProfit进行风控。仓位管理支持五种模式：基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于净亏损后的可用保证金、基于净亏损后的余额，以及固定手数模式。EA通过IsNewBar机制确保每个K线周期只计算一次信号，避免重复交易，同时使用Recount标志在CopyBuffer失败时重新获取数据。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the crossover of two lines (main line Ind and signal line Sign) from the custom ExchangePrice indicator to determine trend direction. Entry conditions: when Ind[1]>Sign[1] (main line above signal line on the previous bar) and Ind[0]<=Sign[0] (main line below or equal on the bar before that), an uptrend is confirmed and a buy position is opened; conversely, when Ind[1]<Sign[1] and Ind[0]>=Sign[0], a downtrend is confirmed and a sell position is opened. Exit conditions include: closing long positions when a downtrend signal appears, closing short positions when an uptrend signal appears, with StopLoss and TakeProfit applied to every trade for risk control. Position sizing supports five modes: based on free margin, based on balance, based on free margin after losses, based on balance after losses, and fixed lot size. The EA uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar cycle, avoiding repeated trades, and employs a Recount flag to re-fetch data when CopyBuffer fails.

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于指标交叉的趋势跟踪方法经典可靠
提供五种仓位管理模式，灵活性高，适应不同风险偏好
使用新K线检查机制，避免同一根K线上重复开仓，减少过度交易
止损止盈参数完整，每笔交易都有风险控制
买卖方向的开仓和平仓均可独立开关控制，便于灵活配置
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on indicator crossover, a classic and reliable trend-following approach
Five position sizing modes offer high flexibility to accommodate different risk preferences
New-bar check mechanism prevents repeated entries on the same bar, reducing overtrading
Complete StopLoss and TakeProfit parameters ensure risk control on every trade
Buy/sell open and close can be independently toggled, allowing flexible configuration
cons: 依赖自定义ExchangePrice指标，指标逻辑不透明，无法验证其有效性
止损1000点和止盈2000点设置过大，可能导致单笔亏损严重
缺乏移动止损（Trailing Stop）机制，盈利头寸无法锁定浮动利润
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生不利入场
信号判断仅依赖两根K线的交叉，缺乏多周期确认或过滤器，容易产生假信号
cons_en: Depends on a custom ExchangePrice indicator whose internal logic is opaque and unverifiable
StopLoss of 1000 points and TakeProfit of 2000 points are very wide, potentially leading to significant single-trade losses
No trailing stop mechanism means profitable positions cannot lock in floating gains
No spread filter, potentially allowing unfavorable entries in high-spread environments
Signal judgment relies on only two bars of crossover data, lacking multi-timeframe confirmation or filters, prone to false signals
improvements: 增加移动止损功能，在价格朝有利方向移动时逐步锁定利润
添加多时间周期确认机制，如更高时间周期趋势过滤，减少假信号
增加点差和波动率过滤，避免在不利市场条件下入场
improvements_en: Add a trailing stop feature to gradually lock in profits as price moves favorably
Implement multi-timeframe confirmation, such as a higher-timeframe trend filter, to reduce false signals
Add spread and volatility filters to avoid entering trades under unfavorable market conditions

risk_points: 止损1000点过大，单笔最大亏损可能占账户较大比例
缺乏点差过滤，在流动性差的市场中可能遭受额外滑点损失
指标逻辑不透明，无法评估信号质量和可靠性
risk_points_en: StopLoss of 1000 points is very wide, potentially causing a single trade loss to represent a large portion of the account
No spread filter may result in additional slippage losses in low-liquidity markets
Indicator logic is opaque, making it impossible to evaluate signal quality and reliability

It uses a new-bar check to avoid repeated entries on the same bar, and manages positions with configurable Stop Loss, Take Profit, and multiple money management modes including lot-based and margin-based sizing.
